description: Manners and grace in everything that I do #selflove #selfcare
transcript: Manners have become a lost art. I maintain grace in every situation because that is control. Allow the external world to make me flustered. I do not meet people where they are. I leave. There is no need for me to be in a reactive state. There's no need for me to fight with you. There's no need for me to argue with you. I will fully disconnect.
